articles.executive_summary: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Zero-Day Exploited for Remote Code Execution. The company says it’s aware of limited exploitation against customers’ firewalls, and it has made IoCs available.

articles.title: Cisco Warns of Exploited Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability
articles.executive_summary: Cisco has warned of an exploited vulnerability in its secure email gateway products, allowing remote attackers to write arbitrary files and execute commands with root privileges. This vulnerability poses a significant operational risk to organizations relying on these products for email security.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability allows unauthenticated, remote attackers to write arbitrary files to the operating system and execute commands with root privileges. This is due to a lack of proper input validation and sanitization in the affected products.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest patches or software upgrades provided by Cisco
Implement network containment or firewall rules to restrict access to the affected products
Monitor system logs for suspicious activity and implement detection indicators for potential exploitation
articles.telegram_snippet: Cisco warns of exploited vulnerability in secure email gateway products, allowing remote attackers to write arbitrary files and execute commands with root privileges. Organizations must apply patches and implement network containment to mitigate this critical risk.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Authenticated RCE Flaw Amid Active Exploitation
articles.executive_summary: Palo Alto Networks has patched a high-severity flaw in PAN-OS software that has been actively exploited. The vulnerability allows remote code execution in the management interface.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability is a case of remote code execution in the management interface of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software, tracked as CVE-2026-0322. The flaw has a CVSS score of 8.6.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest security updates from Palo Alto Networks to patch the vulnerability
Implement network containment or firewall rules to restrict access to the management interface
Monitor logs for suspicious activity and implement detection indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: Palo Alto Networks has patched a high-severity flaw in PAN-OS software, actively exploited for remote code execution in the management interface. Apply security updates and monitor logs for suspicious activity.

articles.title: Cisco Warns of Active Attacks Exploiting New Critical Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability
articles.executive_summary: Attackers are exploiting a critical vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway, allowing them to write files to the appliance's operating system and run commands as root. This vulnerability poses a significant operational risk to organizations relying on the gateway for email filtering.
articles.technical_breakdown: Attackers send a crafted email attachment through the gateway, which, if successful, allows them to write files to the appliance's operating system and run commands as root. This is due to a critical flaw in the gateway's security design.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest patches or software upgrades for Cisco Secure Email Gateway
Implement network containment or firewall rules to block suspicious email traffic
Monitor logs for indicators of compromise, such as unauthorized file writes or command execution
articles.telegram_snippet: Cisco warns of active attacks exploiting a critical vulnerability in Secure Email Gateway, allowing attackers to write files to the OS and run commands as root. Organizations should apply patches and monitor logs for indicators of compromise.

articles.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
articles.executive_summary: A high-severity zero-day vulnerability in Ivanti ICS was exploited by threat actors, highlighting the challenges of vendor patching. The vulnerability, partially patched in July, allowed for authentication bypass and remote code execution.
articles.technical_breakdown: The CVE-2026-104935 vulnerability was only partially patched in July, leaving an opening for threat actors to exploit. The vulnerability allowed for authentication bypass and remote code execution.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest patches for CVE-2026-104935
Implement network segmentation and containment
Monitor for suspicious login attempts and system activity
articles.telegram_snippet: Ivanti ICS zero-day vulnerability exploited, highlighting vendor patching challenges. Apply latest patches and monitor for suspicious activity.
